analysis_definitions.bootstrap: 2000 paired scenario resamples, fixed analysis seed 20260910; every condition for a scenario resampled together.
analysis_definitions.comparators: EDF prominently; other policies, durations, estimators, capacity and any extension are secondary.
analysis_definitions.failures: All planned rows retained; no failed seed replacement; completed pairs with conservative incomplete bounds.
analysis_definitions.inference: Two fresh independent samples per job; execute first. Seeds exclude policy, risk, duration, objective, execution order. No promise of exact regenerated GPU actions.
analysis_definitions.outcomes: Original weighted loss, incorrect closures, corrections, review utilization, missed opportunities, per-agent outcomes.
analysis_definitions.primary: Search minus greedy loss at review duration 2, separately original and competition; frozen estimator.
analysis_definitions.risk: Initial first-action labels; Brier, pointwise reliability and decisions on same public states. No refitting.
analysis_definitions.search: Exact all ordered subsets of at most six released pending requests; math.fsum fixes order-dependent floating-point ties; measured planning wall time and examined candidates.
analysis_definitions.trace_selection: Per workload: numerically first evaluation seed with search lower loss and first with search higher loss than greedy at s=2; if absent use first tie and say so.

authorization.historical_commands: Unchanged deadline limits; Stage 4 has a separate explicit authorization validator.

decision: Declared initial risk and capacity pilots, no evaluation outcomes available
